codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.ti: The curse has left its first marks on your skin. Beneath the scattered scales, your body still feels familiar.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.ap:
Your body has a human outline, with scattered brown and olive scales across your forehead, back and limbs. Small patches of pale scales mark the center of your chest and abdomen.
A short, blunt muzzle projects from your face beneath two small forehead horns.
A stubby tail sits at the base of your spine. Small, dark claws tip your fingers and toes, while your hands and feet retain their human shape.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.pr:
Your changing digestion draws as much nourishment from raw food as from their cooked versions.
With an empty main hand, your claws dig like wooden tools and deal 1 additional damage. Your emerging scales provide 1 point of natural armor.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.co: Your growing horns and tail prevent helmets and leggings from fitting your altered body.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.in:
You begin to crave raw food, and they seem appetizing. Each raw meal strengthens the urge to give in to the changes.
You begin to desire to dig the earth and strike your enemies with your claws.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_0.d: The curse has left its first marks on your skin. Beneath the scattered scales, your body still feels familiar.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.ti: The changes are becoming harder to conceal. Your growing frame carries a strength that your human body never had.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.ap:
You stand two blocks tall, with a broad frame and patches of scales across your shoulders, flanks and limbs. Pale scales run down your chest and belly, while darker patches cover your back. Skin remains visible between them.
Your head sits on an elongated neck, with a projecting muzzle and thick horns that curve backward above your brow.
Your broad hands and feet each bear three dark claws. Your fingers and thumbs can still close around a handle. A long, tapering tail balances your upright body.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.pr:
Your sturdier frame grants 1 additional heart, and your hardening scales provide 3 points of natural armor.
With an empty main hand, your claws deal 3 damage and dig with the speed and harvesting strength of stone tools.
Your stronger jaws let you eat 50% faster. Raw food nourish you as well as their cooked versions.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.co:
Helmets and leggings cannot accommodate your horns and tail. Your broad, clawed feet have also outgrown boots.
Your heavy body reduces your swimming speed by 15%.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.in:
Waiting for food to cook feels increasingly unnecessary. Raw food tempt you to eat them as they are.
Indulging that appetite strengthens your draconic instincts.
You begin to desire to dig the earth and strike your enemies with your claws.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_1.d: The changes are becoming harder to conceal. Your growing frame carries a strength that your human body never had.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.ti: Standing upright takes an unfamiliar effort. Whenever you break into a run, your body knows another way to move.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.ap:
Most of your body is covered in earthy scales, with pale plates along your throat, chest and abdomen. A sloping neck carries your heavy head forward, beneath swept horns and a broad muzzle.
Your slightly forward-leaning frame stands 2.2 blocks tall. Digitigrade hind legs rest on broad, clawed toes, with raised heels and a thick tail extending behind your hips.
Each forepaw has three thick, clawed digits and pads underneath, with no thumb. You stand with your torso leaning slightly forward and drop onto all fours to run or sneak.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.pr:
Your powerful build grants 4 additional hearts and 50% knockback resistance. Thick scales provide 15 points of natural armor.
With an empty main hand, your claws dig like iron tools and strike with the base damage of an iron sword (6). Your strength increases all melee damage by 25%.
Running on all fours increases your sprinting speed by 20%.
You eat twice as fast. Raw food nourish you as well as their cooked versions.
With a saddle, you can transport humanoid mobs.
If you let a pillager ride you, they will fight for you.
Your paw pads reduce fall damage by 50%.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.co:
Your altered proportions no longer fit any armor. Without a thumb, you carry items in your mouth, but tools and weapons slip free when you try to dig or strike with them. You cannot operate tools or weapons.
When hunger falls to 3 or less, you can no longer maintain your upright stance and must walk on all fours until you have eaten enough.
Pillagers may see you as a potential mount. Try to avoid them if you don't want to become one.
Your heavy body reduces your swimming speed by 25%.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.in:
Waiting for food to cook feels increasingly unnecessary. Raw food tempt you to eat them as they are.
Indulging that appetite strengthens your draconic instincts.
You begin to desire to dig the earth and strike your enemies with your claws.
Moving on all fours exhilarates you and strengthens your draconic instincts. The longer you stay low, the more comfortable it feels.
Carrying a rider keeps you on all fours may make you forget how to stand upright.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_2.d: Standing upright takes an unfamiliar effort. Whenever you break into a run, your body knows another way to move.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.ti: A broad, horned shape moves across the earth on four heavy paws. The drake you have become feels entirely at home in its own skin.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.ap:
You are a broad, low-bodied drake. Olive-brown scales cover your back and flanks, with pale, stone-colored plates along your throat, chest and belly. Your deep torso rests between powerful shoulders and muscular haunches.
A thick, plated neck supports your heavy head. A blunt snout sits above a deep lower jaw; dark horns sweep back from your brow, with smaller spurs framing your cheeks.
Your four sturdy legs end in broad paws, each with three thick toes, firm pads and dark talons. Raised heels and angled joints support your quadrupedal stance. A heavy tail tapers behind you.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.pr:
Your fully developed body grants 6 additional hearts, followed by a 10% bonus increase to maximum health. Your heavy build provides 50% knockback resistance.
Your dense scales now reduce incoming damage by 75%, replacing the need for armor.
With an empty main hand, your claws dig like diamond tools and strike with the base damage of a diamond sword (7). Your strength increases all melee damage by another 50%.
Your four-footed stride increases normal movement speed by 30% and sprinting speed by 45%. You eat twice as fast, gaining cooked-food nourishment from raw food.
With a saddle, you can transport humanoid mobs.
Pillagers remain neutral, but may try to give you the missing riding equipment if you already wear part of the set. With a full set of cursed riding equipment, nearby pillagers will fight for you.
Primary ability - Body Slam: Rush forward up to 3 blocks, stopping on an enemy or obstacle. Sweep enemies in front for damage equal to your maximum health. Costs 1 drumstick (2 hunger points); 5-second cooldown.
Your paw pads reduce fall damage by 75%.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.co:
Your body can only move on all fours. Your bulkier build is too broad for passages only one block wide.
No armor fits your frame. You carry tools and weapons in your mouth, but they fall when used to dig or strike.
A riding pillager may control your movement through cursed reins when pursuing a foe.
Your heavy body reduces your swimming speed by 35%.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_3.d: A broad, horned shape moves across the earth on four heavy paws. The drake you have become feels entirely at home in its own skin.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.st:
A prickling sensation spreads across your forehead and down your back. When you reach for it, patches of skin stiffen beneath your fingers and divide into small, hard scales. More patches surface along your arms and shins, while paler scales press through the skin of your chest and abdomen.
Pressure gathers around your nose and mouth. They push forward together, drawing your jaw into a short muzzle. Two tender spots above your brow swell, then harden into little horns.
A tug at the base of your spine makes you shift your weight. Something presses outward, lengthening into a stubby tail. You turn to look and feel it move with your hips, a new limb you have not yet learned to control.
Your fingertips and toes tingle as the nails darken and thicken into small claws. You flex them against your palms, feeling their hard points where your nails used to be.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.st:
The skin around your existing scales begins to tighten. New rows spread outward, joining the isolated patches across your shoulders, sides and limbs. The pale scales on your abdomen broaden toward your chest as your torso fills out beneath them.
A deep stretch travels through your legs and back, lifting your eye level as your frame grows taller. Your neck lengthens, easing your head forward; your jaw follows as the muzzle pushes farther from your face. The small horns above your brow thicken and curve backward.
Your hands and feet feel crowded as they broaden around growing claws. The short points lengthen into sturdy talons, forcing your fingers and toes farther apart. You curl your fingers experimentally and find that your thumbs can still meet them.
Your tail pulls at the base of your spine, extending section by section. Muscles tighten along its length, and it swings behind you as you lean forward, helping you recover your balance.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.st:
The remaining gaps between your scales narrow as hardened skin spreads over your body. Pale plates knit together along your throat and belly. Your neck thickens and slopes forward, drawing your head and shoulders into a slight forward lean as your muzzle and horns grow heavier.
Your calves tighten sharply. Your heels lift, and your feet lengthen beneath you until your weight shifts onto broad, clawed toes. Trying to stand as before sends you swaying; your tail thickens and extends behind your hips, countering the pull of your upper body.
You reach for support, but your thumbs are shortening against your palms. Your remaining fingers thicken into three clawed digits, while firm pads swell underneath. Closing your hands no longer makes a proper grip. You lower them to the ground and feel the pads take your weight.
Your shoulders settle between your forelimbs. When you move forward, all four limbs fall into step before you consciously arrange them. You push yourself back into a gently forward-leaning stance, but your next attempt to run brings your forepaws down again.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.st:
A deep pressure spreads through your chest and back, drawing you down onto all fours. Your shoulders broaden, your ribs expand, and your torso stretches between forelegs and hind legs. The weight that once rested over your hips settles across all four limbs.
Your arms thicken into forelegs as the wrists and elbows shift to support you. Pads spread beneath the three toes of each paw, and the claws lengthen into heavy talons. Your hindquarters fill out with muscle, holding the raised joints firmly above the ground.
Your neck swells beneath its plates. The muzzle pushes outward and widens, your lower jaw deepening beneath it. Your horns sweep farther back, and smaller spurs press out along your cheeks. Scales pack tightly across your growing body as the pale plates of your underside broaden.
Your tail grows heavier at the base and lengthens behind you. As the pressure eases, you shift your weight to rise, but your hips and spine no longer support an upright stance. You plant your forepaws again, then take your first steady steps in the completed body of a drake.
tooltip.ssc-extras.blinding_rein: Inflicts Drake Curse. Functions as Cursed Reins. Pillagers close the blinkers for battle and reopen them at the stable.
tooltip.ssc-extras.cursed_reins: Inflicts Drake Curse. A rider can steer a saddled permanent drake while giving movement input.
tooltip.ssc-extras.cursed_saddle: Inflicts Drake Curse. Allows other players to ride a permanent drake.
tooltip.ssc-extras.drake_mount_set_bonus: Set bonus: Wearing both pieces binds them and makes you loyal to the pillager faction.
tooltip.ssc-extras.riders_chest: 54 shared slots. Sneak-use the drake, press inventory while riding, or use your SSC secondary ability.
tooltip.ssc-extras.drake_chest_requireme: Fits permanent drake players and natural drakes.
tooltip.ssc-extras.netherite_claw_tips: Hands: netherite empty-hand tools and claws.
tooltip.ssc-extras.netherite_claw_tips_f: Feet: +50% knockback resistance, +20% speed, -30% sprint and sprint-jump hunger drain.
tooltip.ssc-extras.drake_pillager_rider: Stage 2+: sneak-use a pillager to carry it; sneak again to cancel.
tooltip.ssc-extras.cleansing_key.cleanse: Curse Cleansed for 30s: stops cursed items equipping themselves.
tooltip.ssc-extras.cleansing_key.release: Drops worn cursed collars, reins and saddles. Costs 1 use per item.
tooltip.ssc-extras.metal_cuffs.suppress: Blocks instinct gain, spending 1 durability per instinct blocked.
tooltip.ssc-extras.metal_cuffs.first: Also prevents buildup before the first transformation.
tooltip.ssc-extras.metal_cuffs.durabilit: The instinct gauge outline shows remaining cuff durability.
tooltip.ssc-extras.metal_cuffs.pair: Wear at wrists and ankles to halve wear on each pair.
message.ssc-extras.metal_cuffs.weak: The magic within you surges. You feel the cuffs around your %s trembling and weakening.
message.ssc-extras.metal_cuffs.critical: The cuffs around your %s are about to break. Replace or repair them if you wish to keep your current form.
message.ssc-extras.drake.hunger_collapse: Your legs are shaking from exhaustion, and you fall down to all fours. You don't have enough energy to support your upright stance!
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager_equipp: A pillager has equipped you with %s.
message.ssc-extras.collar.auto_equipped: The cursed collar has fastened itself around your neck!
gamerule.CursedCollarAutoEquipForCursedP: Cursed collars in inventories or opened containers equip cursed players with empty neck slots. Permanent forms remain exempt.
gamerule.CursedCollarAutoEquipForUncurse: Cursed collars in inventories or opened containers equip uncursed players with empty neck slots.
gamerule.PillagerMountRecruitingForDrake: Pillagers equip drakes at every stage with missing cursed reins and saddles, and complete the equipment of those who are missing a piece.
gamerule.PillagerMountRecruitingForUncur: Pillagers equip uncursed players with cursed reins and saddles.
gamerule.RemoveBlackoutDuringTransformat: Prevents blindness, darkness, and dark screen overlays during transformation.
gamerule.UnlockedPermanentFormProgressio: Unlock permanent progression for other forms
Allows other forms to reach permanent form through instinct without an Echo Catalyst. When disabled, only SSC Extras forms and configured exceptions retain their existing progression routes.
power.ssc-extras.drake/body_slam.name: Body Slam
power.ssc-extras.drake/body_slam.descrip: Rush forward up to 3 blocks, stopping on an enemy or obstacle. Sweep enemies in front for damage equal to your maximum health. Costs 1 drumstick (2 hunger points); 5-second cooldown.
message.ssc-extras.drake.roam_edge: You are getting close to the edge of the drake stable...
message.ssc-extras.drake.roam_outside: You have roamed outside your stable...
message.ssc-extras.drake.roam_spotted: A pillager just spotted you outside the range...
message.ssc-extras.drake.escape_marked: The pillagers think you are trying to escape...
message.ssc-extras.drake.pursuit_lost: The pillagers seemed to have lost you, but they will keep searching for a while..
message.ssc-extras.drake.escape_success: You've escaped your fate as a mount, for now.
message.ssc-extras.drake.taming_collar: After your repeated escapes, a pillager locks a cursed taming collar around your neck.
message.ssc-extras.drake.struggle_free: You struggle free of the leash!
message.ssc-extras.drake.battle_treat: A pillager rewards you with a treat after the battle.
tooltip.ssc-extras.taming_collar.restric: Keeps drakes on all fours. Prevents opening fence gates, breaking or placing blocks, and freely untying your leash.
message.ssc-extras.drake.last_escape_war: You sense that being caught after your next escape will bring punishment. This is your last chance.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.mount_: Pillager: %s, hold still. I'm getting on; we're guarding the outpost.
Pillager: %s, steady now. I'm getting on; we're making the rounds.
Pillager: %s, brace yourself. I'm mounting up; there's an enemy to fight.
Pillager: %s, hold still. I'm riding you back to your stall.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.battle: Pillager: %s, enemy ahead! Turn toward them and keep moving.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.escape: Pillager: %s! You're too far out. Stop there; you're coming back with us.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.range_: Pillager: %s, this way. Stay within the stable's range.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.escape: Pillager: Caught you, %s. This lead will keep you close. Back to your stall.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.recall: Pillager: Come along, %s. Follow the lead; it's time to return to the stable.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.stable: Pillager: %s, back where you belong. Stay tied here and settle down.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.feed: Pillager: Hungry, %s? Here. Eat your meat.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.hand_f: Pillager: Still not eating, %s? Open up. I'll feed you.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.cataly: Pillager: Open up, %s. This catalyst will help you become a proper drake.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.reward: Pillager: Good work, %s. You've earned this meat.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.stable: Pillager: Listen carefully, %s. Stay in your stall until you are rideable. Get caught outside before then and we'll leash you back and feed you a catalyst. When you are strong and quadrupedal enough to be ridden, stay within %s blocks of the stable. Be inside the stable after midnight, unless you have excuses. Those are the rules.
message.ssc-extras.drake.service_promise: As a registered mount, the keepers promise you a reward after ten days of good service: a rewarding ritual. Service continues while you roam. A keeper checks once after midnight; stay inside the stable unless you're excused.
message.ssc-extras.drake.service_reset: A keeper checked after midnight and found you absent from the stable without a valid excuse. The promise is broken; the ten days of good service must begin again.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_soon: Eight days of good service. The keepers are preparing your reward: the permanent mount transformation. Soon your soul will be a drake, bound to this stall even beyond death.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_ready: Ten days of good service! Three keepers will come for you and lead you to your hay for the permanent mount ritual.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_gatherin: Three keepers are coming for you. They will leash you and take you to your assigned stall.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_held: Two keepers hold you firmly on the hay while the third prepares the binding chant.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_begin: The third keeper begins chanting. You struggle beneath falling runes as the other two hold you on the hay. The soulbinding ritual has begun.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_change: The chant drives your instincts higher, rapidly advancing your drake transformation.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_soul: The chant sinks deeper. Your soul is becoming the drake itself. You will be only respawned as a drake from now on.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_interrup: The ritual has been interrupted. Your service is remembered; the keepers will gather and begin again when they can.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_complete: Your soul is a drake now. With a drake's soul, you've forgotten how to stand upright. You are the stable's permanent mount. The Cursed Moon can no longer change your form. Your cursed equipment is Soulbound, and death will return you to your stall. You can no longer leave the range without a rider.
message.ssc-extras.drake.soul_respawn: Your drake soul returns to its assigned stall.
message.ssc-extras.drake.soul_freed: The drake transformation is completely undone. Your soul is free.
message.ssc-extras.drake.body_reverted_f: The drake transformation is undone, but your mind remains feral.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_due: Caught escaping this stable six times. The keepers will now perform the full feralization punishment ritual.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_gath: Three pillagers are coming to leash you to your stall. This time they intend to take away your human mind.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_held: Two keepers hold you firmly on the hay while their leader prepares the feralization chant.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_feed: The leader will feed you full beastization catalyst until you are a mindless beast.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_begi: The leader begins chanting while the other keepers hold you still. Your mind takes a translucent shape above your body, ready to be feralized.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_mind: Your feralized mind settles back into your body. The keepers finish the ritual.

Words and memories dissolve from your brain. Only your mount name and meat still mean anything. The leader feeds you more catalysts to make sure your brain is permanently shrunken, and he will keeps feeding you until your body is completely transformed into a Feral Drake.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_comp: The ritual is complete. Your drake mind knows only food, sleep, and its mount name.
tooltip.ssc-extras.iron_drake_shoes_hand: Hands: lock thumbs, can't carry items in the hands, and adds +5 empty-hand damage.
tooltip.ssc-extras.iron_drake_shoes_feet: Feet: reduce sprinting hunger consumption by 30%.
tooltip.ssc-extras.iron_drake_shoes_dura: Wear down like iron boots. Dipping into lava instantly melts worn hand and foot shoes.
tooltip.ssc-extras.iron_drake_shoes_curs: Inflicts Drake Curse and Curse of Binding. Shod front paws cannot break, place or use blocks except hay, or use tools.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_warning: A keeper saw you tampering with the stable (%s/3). The third time, your paws will be fitted with cursed iron shoes.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_caught: A keeper caught you tampering with the stable for the third time. Your paws will be fitted with cursed iron shoes.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_gatheri: Three keepers gather: two to hold you, and one to fit the shoes. They lead you to the hay.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_held: They roll you onto your back on the hay. Two keepers hold you while the third raises a three-clawed iron shoe.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_paw_0: The keeper grips your first front limb and closes an iron shoe over its paw and thumb.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_paw_1: The keeper holds your other front limb and fits its shoe. Soon your mouth must carry what your paws cannot.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_paw_2: The keeper grips your first hind limb and fits an identical shoe on your paw.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_paw_3: The keeper holds your last hind limb while fitting its shoe. The binding curse seals all four iron shoes.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_complet: Your iron-shod paws cannot work blocks or tools; you can still sleep on hay. You now need to carry items in your mouth. Empty-paw strikes are stronger, and sprinting is more efficient now.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.no_sta: Cannot perform a ritual without an assigned stall.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.not_re: Cannot perform a ritual while dead or in Spectator mode.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.busy: A ritual or ride is already in progress.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.unavai: Your assigned stall is currently unavailable. Its hay and keepers are needed for the ritual.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.starte: Started %s for %s at their assigned stall.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.no_ped: Cannot perform Guardian Awakening without a bound Gargoyle Pedestal.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.guardi: Guardian Awakening requires Guardian stage 2 and the complete Guardian equipment set.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.pedest: Your bound Gargoyle Pedestal is currently unavailable.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.guardi: Started %s for %s at their bound pedestal.
message.ssc-extras.purge_command.empty: No cursed equipment is worn by %s.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_soul_ret: Your transformed drake soul returns to your body. The keepers begin sealing the bond.
message.ssc-extras.drake.bound_return: Your mount bond with this stable turns you back toward the stable's range.
message.ssc-extras.drake.bound_return_st: Following your soul's binding with this stable, your body has returned to your stall on its own.
message.ssc-extras.drake.leashed_return_: After a long journey, your master managed to drag you back to your stall.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_feed: The keeper feeds you catalysts, your instincts surge.
message.ssc-extras.sentient_catalyst.1: The catalyst stimulated some neuron forming! *It looks like it's starting to understand putting blocks down and pressing its paws on them.*
message.ssc-extras.sentient_catalyst.2: More neuron grew in the tiny feral brain. Tools are starting to make sense to its wild mind, although still simple-minded.
message.ssc-extras.sentient_catalyst.3: Your mind grew, words and senses are back. Though you are still used to animalistic stances and making animal noises.
message.ssc-extras.sentient_catalyst.4: Your brain grew back to its intended size, and your vocal ability and stance are restored.
item.ssc-extras.sentient_catalyst.toolti: Able to stimulate neuron growth in an animal's brain. Might need multiple uses for a better effect.
screen.ssc-extras.merchant.sure: Are you sure you want to be a mount?
screen.ssc-extras.merchant.consequence: You will be harnessed, led into the pen, converted to be a rideable drake mount. You'll worth a fortune!
message.ssc-extras.merchant.accepted: Mount Merchant: A willing mount waiting to be ridden. Into the pen with you.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.pretend: You whimpered no, but you couldn't take your eager eyes away from those mounts. Noticing a hesitation in your voice, the Mount Merchant grabs you and says: Don't lie to me, I know you want it. You will make a fine mount. Into the pen with you.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.collar: Mount Merchant: That looks perfect on you, %s. As the collar fastens around your neck, you can no longer remember your own name, only %s.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.enter: Mount Merchant: Reins, saddle, and you might want to take off your equipments. This way, %s.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.stage_0: Mount Merchant: I know you've got the potential! Look! You've got a little tail now!
message.ssc-extras.merchant.stage_1: Mount Merchant: Almost there. Look at your digits on your hands and feet; they are getting stronger and thicker.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.stage_2: Mount Merchant: There you are, nice and strong. Don't miss your thumb too much, since now you are only meant to be a mount. Get on all fours and enjoy the ground under your new paw pads. Don't you enjoy it?
message.ssc-extras.merchant.ready: Mount Merchant: A fine drake you are, %s. You are gonna make me rich.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.return_to_co: Mount Merchant: Now, now, I need to get back to the counter. My customers could be here any time soon.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.sold: Mount Merchant: Sold, %s is yours! No refunds!
message.ssc-extras.merchant.arrived: Pillager: Here we are, %s. This stall is yours.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.interrupted: The merchant's conversion has been interrupted by unforeseen circumstances.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.new_keeper: Woah, free real estate! I'm gonna be rich!
message.ssc-extras.merchant.offer.no_sto: I'm out of mounts to help with your transformation. Come back after I've restocked.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.greeting.hum: Hi there, you look like you need a mount to alleviate the pressure on those sore feet! I've got the best mount here.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.greeting.oth: Hi there, you look like you need a mount to alleviate the pressure on those sore paws! I've got the best mount here.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.greeting.fer: Shoo! Shoo! I'm trying to start a business here!
message.ssc-extras.merchant.greeting.dra: Hi there, you look awfully like the one Im missing in my pen! Have you considered to be a mount?
message.ssc-extras.merchant.greeting.wai: Be patient, %s. Your future buyer might appear at any second.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.greeting.vil: What brought you here? Got nothing better to do?
message.ssc-extras.merchant.offer.human: Wow, really? You will need to use some upgrades since your spindly legs are not suitable for the job, and I have them.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.offer.other: I'm sorry, I can't do much about your curse. Find me again when you are human.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.offer.drake: Great, you just need some touch ups.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.offer.no_dem: Sorry buddy, there's not enough demand right now. I don't want to keep extra merchandise in my inventory.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.released: You're free, %s. Just can't afford to upkeep additional drakes when there is no demand.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.offer.ready: Perfect, you are already in shape!
message.ssc-extras.merchant.return: Hey, %s, who let you out? Get back to your pen.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.lost: %s, looks like you are lost. Get in the pen.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.recruit: What do we have here, %s? A lost mount recruit! Don't worry, I will make a good mount out of you.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.purchase: Mount Merchant: %s for %s emeralds. Take the lead.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.pet_register: Mount Merchant: %s is now registered as your pet.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.pet_owner: Mount Merchant: %s is now your owner.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.unavailable: Mount Merchant: Unequip anythings thats in the way for my reins and saddle, or finish any other arrangement first.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.buyer.greeti: Buyer: I need a good mount for the ride home. What do you recommend?
message.ssc-extras.merchant.buyer.recomm: Mount Merchant: Take a look at %s. A fine drake, ready for a rider.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.buyer.consid: Buyer: Hmm... a fine choice. Let me see how many stalls I have available.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.buyer.collec: Mount Merchant: This way! The gate is open. Go into the pen and collect your mounts.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.captured_ent: Mount Merchant: Caught you, %s. Into the pen, and stay where I put you.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.captured_rea: Mount Merchant: Back where you belong, %s. Now wait for your buyer.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.escape_chase: Mount Merchant: Stop right there, %s! You are not leaving my pen.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.escape_caugh: Mount Merchant: Thought you could get away, %s? Back in the pen.
message.ssc-extras.merchant.escape_colla: Mount Merchant: That's enough. A taming collar for you. Disobedient mounts are less valuable. Maybe I should get some of that catalyst, powerful stuff, that will make it simpler.
tooltip.ssc-extras.golem_core: A magical core that powers and controls the Guardian.
message.ssc-extras.guardian.protect: *THREAT DETECTED. PROTECTION PROTOCOL ENGAGED. INTERCEPTING HOSTILE.*
message.ssc-extras.guardian.day_sleep: Your stone body can only rest during the day.
message.ssc-extras.guardian.village_requ: The Guardian quest requires a village with at least three villagers.
message.ssc-extras.guardian.pedestal_tak: This pedestal is bound to another Guardian.
message.ssc-extras.guardian.stage_two_hi: You feel you have reached the limit of your current form. Only an external force can help you progress further.
message.ssc-extras.guardian.service_offe: Villager: If you can protect us for 10 days, we can improve your current form and make you better and stronger.
message.ssc-extras.guardian.service_day_: Villager: You have protected us for 5 days, and we thank you for your serive. Keep us safe, and we will keep our promise.
Villager: We thank you for 8 days of protection. We are preparing what we need to strengthen your form. Give us 2 more days.
message.ssc-extras.guardian.service_rese: A villager has died. Your ten days of service must begin again.
message.ssc-extras.guardian.ritual_begin: The villagers approach. Your service has earned the Ritual of the Guardian.
message.ssc-extras.guardian.ritual_soul: The runes call to your soul. It leaves your body and enters the waiting core.
message.ssc-extras.guardian.ritual_stone: Liquid stone closes over your empty body. The villagers begin to shape your new vessel.
message.ssc-extras.guardian.ritual_comma: *CORE ONLINE. DESIGNATION: %s. PRIMARY DIRECTIVE: SERVE THIS VILLAGE. PROTECT ITS PEOPLE. ENGAGE THEIR ENEMIES.*
message.ssc-extras.guardian.ritual_compl: The chains fall away. You are %s.
message.ssc-extras.guardian.rebuilt: *CORE INSTALLED. VESSEL ONLINE. PROTECTION DIRECTIVE RESTORED.*
message.ssc-extras.guardian.blackout_rec: Time passed. Someone recovered your core and inserted it into a deactivated Guardian body.
origin.ssc-extras.form_runebound_guardia: Stone begins to replace your skin. It offers some protection, but weighs on your movements. Your new claws make your bare hands more dangerous.
codex.form.ssc-extras.runebound_guardian: Runebound Guardian (Stage 0)
The first patches of stone have settled into your skin. Each movement carries a weight your body did not have before.

Patches of gray stone scales spread across your skin. Small horns grow on your head, and a short muzzle stretches out.
Wing buds rise behind your shoulders, accompanied by a short tail. Small claws tip your fingers and toes, with paw pads forming beneath them.

The stone forming over your skin offers some natural armor and resistance to damage, magic and knockback.
Your small claws make your barehanded attacks stronger.

Your body feels heavier and moves more slowly, especially in direct sunlight.
Your wings and tail leave no room for chest armor or leggings.

You find yourself lingering near villages, watching over their people.
Standing on a Gargoyle Pedestal feels strangely comfortable. Staying a little longer won't hurt, right?

Your skin tightens as patches of gray stone forms on the surface. A dull pressure pushes your face into a short muzzle, and small horns rise above your head. Something cyan flickers in your eyes.
You shift your shoulders and feel two unfamiliar buds against your back. A short tail follows your movement. Your nails darken into claws, and you feel your limbs getting more rigid.
power.ssc-extras.guardian/body_0.name: Runebound Stone Body
power.ssc-extras.guardian/body_0.descrip: Stone begins to replace your skin. It offers some protection, but weighs on your movements. Your new claws make your bare hands more dangerous.
origin.ssc-extras.form_runebound_guardia: Your stone body grows stronger, and your claws work a bit better. Magic begins to nourish you more than typical food.
codex.form.ssc-extras.runebound_guardian: Runebound Guardian (Stage 1)
Stone spreads across your growing frame, and magic begins to satisfy an appetite that food no longer fills as easily.

Stone scales spread across your growing frame. Your muzzle lengthens beneath swept horns and cyan eyes. Runes glow along your forearms.
Your wings begin to unfold, and a heavier tail hangs behind your hips. Broad, clawed hands are made to attack and protect, and padded feet carry the weight of your changing body.

Your growing frame grants more health and natural armor. Heavy stone reduces knockback you receive while making your enemies' attacks subtle.
Your claws dig and strike like stone tools.
Absorbed magic and potions restore health and hunger. Hot ground cannot burn your petrified feet, and debuffs fade sooner as your body absorbs the effect partially.
You can rest by day or night. Villagers can repair you during the day.

Your heavier body moves more slowly, especially in direct sunlight. Armor no longer fits as your frame grows.
Your broad claws struggle with normal tools and weapons, while food only partly satisfies your hunger.
You can no longer bring yourself to harm villagers.

The villagers put you at ease, and you feel the need to protect them. The village feel like somewhere you should stay.
You crave magic like a dry sponge.

New stone scales spreads across your body. Your shoulders broaden, your muzzle lengthens, and cyan markings appears on you.
The buds behind your shoulders stretch into small wings. Your tail grows heavier, and your hands and feet broaden around their claws. You feel magic seeps into you, nourishes you, and sates your appetite.
power.ssc-extras.guardian/body_1.name: Runebound Stone Body
power.ssc-extras.guardian/body_1.descrip: Your stone body grows stronger, and your claws work like stone tools. Magic begins to nourish you as food loses its appeal. The villagers feel like people you should protect.
origin.ssc-extras.form_runebound_guardia: Living stone replaces flesh, sustained by a reserve of magic. Your claws work like iron tools, and your wings can carry you. Sunlight drains you away from a pedestal. Only the villagers can help you complete the change.
codex.form.ssc-extras.runebound_guardian: Runebound Guardian (Stage 2)
Hunger fades beneath a steady current of magic. Your body has become living stone, and the village calls you toward a final change.

Your body is covered in gray stone, with heavy stone plates across your body. Cyan runes shine along your limbs, and broad wings rise behind your back.
Swept horns frame your glowing eyes and heavy muzzle. Raised heels support your body with clawed feet, while a long, plated tail balances your stance.

Stone body grants you more health and natural armor, granting you strong resistance to damage and knockback. It's especially effective against projectiles.
Your claws dig and strike like iron tools. High energy makes your attacks faster and stronger.
Absorbed magic and potions restore health and energy; stone heals half a heart when consumed. Gargoyle Pedestal recharges you.
Your wings can carry you into flight. Your digitigrade stance lets you step higher.
Primary ability — Claw Swipe: Sweep your claws to stike down your enemies, and its damage grows with your level.
Secondary ability — Villager Sight: Sense nearby villagers.
Hot ground cannot burn your stone feet, and lava cannot harm you, except your head, due to your head and internals are still made of flesh. Debuffs fade quickly as they are absorbed by your runes. Villagers can repair your stone plates if you are damaged.

Your heavy body moves even more slowly. No armor fits, and normal tools and weapons are unusable for your thick rigid claws.
Food no longer nourishes you, and you cannot heal naturally as you are now sustained by the magic within you. 
Direct sunlight drains your reserve.
No energy leaves you barely moving and drains your health until you are recharged from a pedestal.
You can rest only during the day. 
To advance to the next stage, you will need the villagers' help.
Protect your bound village for ten days. Make sure every villager survives. They may be able to offer you for an upgrade afterwards.

The last traces of skin on your body disappear beneath gray stone. A steady current of magic fills your body, overtaking your needs for normal sustenance, lighting the runes across your limbs.
Your heels rise and soles extend, marking you as digitigrade as your weight settles onto broad, clawed feet. Wings stretch outward, and your tail steadies the unfamiliar stance. You spread your wings and feel the stone lift from the ground.
power.ssc-extras.guardian/body_2.name: Runebound Stone Body
power.ssc-extras.guardian/body_2.descrip: Living stone replaces flesh, sustained by a reserve of magic. Your claws work like iron tools, and your wings can carry you. Sunlight drains you away from a pedestal. Only the villagers can help you complete the change.
origin.ssc-extras.form_runebound_guardia: Your soul now resides in a golem core. Your body is nearly indestructible. Your claws are equivalent to diamonds, and your new body comes with a larger energy reserve. A broken body is not the end, a broken core is.
codex.form.ssc-extras.runebound_guardian: Runebound Guardian (Permanent)
A towering stone guardian stands watch over the village. Within its carved body, your soul rests in the core that gives it life.

You are a broad, upright guardian of carved gray stone. Thick plates protects your chest, shoulders and limbs, with cyan runes glowing with magic.
Swept horns rise above your head, completed with a heavy muzzle and luminous eyes. Large wings extend behind your shoulders, and a long tail tapers behind your body.
Your claws are sharp, and broad, waiting to tear your enemies apart. Raised heels and angled leg joints support your stance. Your soul resides within the core, keeping the runes and your body animated.

Your completed vessel grants more heart and natural armor. Dense stone massively reduces incoming damage, especially good against projectiles. You are immune to knockback, magical damage, fire and ordinary debuffs.
Your deadly claws dig like diamond tools. On high energy, you gain increased attack speed and damage.
Your energy capacity is doubled, and flight consumes less energy. Absorbed magic and potions restore health and energy; stone heals half a heart. 
Primary ability: Overdrive, doubling movement speed, attack speed, attack damage and energy use. While Overdrive is active, empty-hand attacks are replaced with Claw Swipe that scales with your level.
Secondary ability — Villager Sight: Sense friendlies and hostiles, protect the ones with cyan outlines (yellow if in danger), attack those with red outlines.
You are eager to protect villagers and will sprint faster towards them.
Your digitigrade stance allows you to step higher. 
Villagers repair will repair you during the day.
Every day of protection will grant you more discounts. Guardians may be activated when villagers are attacked.

Your stone body are slowed. Normal tools, weapons and food are unusable to your body, and no armor fits your stone frame.
Your body now solely depends on its energy reserve. With no energy, you are nothing but an inactive statue. You can rest only during the day.
When nearby villagers are attacked, your protocol will be overriden.
Destroying the core kills you.
Your brittle body takes extra fall damage.
Direct sunlight drains your energy away. 
You shut down if you are low in energy. Sneak on pedestal to enter your destined form.
GOLEM EXISTS TO PROTECT.

The runes draw your soul into the waiting core. Your body falls silent, and liquid stone closes over it. Beyond your reach, the villagers begin to carve.
When the core returns to the finished vessel, the runes awaken. Your claws press against the pedestal. A designation settles into your thoughts, followed by a duty that feels impossible to question.
The chains fall away. Your new body answers.
power.ssc-extras.guardian/body_3.name: Runebound Stone Body
power.ssc-extras.guardian/body_3.descrip: Your soul now resides in a golem core. Nearly indestructible. Your claws are equivalent to diamonds, and your new body comes with a larger energy reserve. A broken body is not the end, a broken core is.
